notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.6.0 - Gear and Glory
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

We're excited to launch [b]Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.6.0 - Gear and Glory[/b]! This update introduces [i]new equipment slots[/i], a wealth of new gear, expanded server capacity for up to 10 players, and numerous fixes and tweaks to enhance your epic journey. Dive into the changelog below!

[h2]New Features & Content[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Equipment Slot: Bracers[/b] - Equip powerful bracers to boost your stats!
[*][b]New Equipment Slot: Charm[/b] - Add charms for unique bonuses!
[*]Added a visual effect when a skillbar slot is used.
[*]Introduced a ton of new gear for the new equipment slots.
[*]Increased max players for dedicated servers to [b]10[/b].
[*]New elite in Vault of the Vanished: [b]Icescythe Lord[/b].
[*]Added tutorial message for [b]Combined Backpack[/b] mechanics.
[*]Dedicated servers now show messages when a player defeats an elite or boss.
[*][b]Temple of Valaark[/b] update progress: [b]50%[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved mercenaries performance to handle up to [b]30 mercs[/b].
[*]Mercs now count as normal party members.
[*]Mercs no longer dismiss when connecting to a server.
[*]Increased character window size to fit all stats.
[*]Adjusted color of player names in social messages for better visibility.
[*]Improved stats for [b]Crypt Lord Kharzul[/b].
[*]Added message when a debuff resists cleansing.
[*]Ctrl+C now gracefully shuts down servers.
[*]Start a server with specific capacity using the-capacity parameter.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed UI issues on ultra-wide monitors.
[*]Fixed damage shields not showing correct damage type.
[*]Resolved bug with chests and the new Unique Reward System.
[*]Fixed incorrect “You have gathered a quest item” message appearing without the quest.
[*]Fixed bug with mob knockback causing issues when the victim dies.
[*]Corrected [b]Pyrovax[/b] max health.
[*]Fixed bug where mercs could spawn behind walls.
[*]Resolved issues with [b]Corrupted Dwarves[/b] and [b]Braldur[/b].
[*]Fixed dedicated server monster-related bug.
[*]Fixed item dragging from inventory to chest house.
[*]Corrected [b]Zyrath[/b] zone ID.
[*]Ensured all quest completion Achievements are checked consistently.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Players can no longer be invited while in combat.
[/list]

Thank you for your support! Jump in, explore the new features, and share your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/8MkSWjXwab]Discord[/url] or in the Steam discussions. Let’s forge epic legends together! 🙌

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.5.0 - The Server Update
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! We're excited to launch Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.5.0, bringing a major feature - player-hosted servers - alongside new content, balance tweaks, and bug fixes to enhance your journey. Dive into the details below:

[h2]Major Feature: Player-Hosted Servers[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Player-hosted servers have arrived![/b] You can now run your own headless server for *Ancient Kingdoms* on any computer or in the cloud.
[list]
[*] A new [i]server[/i] folder is included in the game directory.
[*] Start a server using the [i]server.exe[/i] (server.x86_64 in Linux) executable with this command:
[code]server.exe -name "Server Name" -password "Server Password"[/code]
[code]server.x86_64 -name "Server Name" -password "Server Password"[/code]
[/list][/list][h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Hunt: Magmadrake[/b] – Face a new challenging hunt in the world of *Ancient Kingdoms*.
[*] [b]New Cooking Recipes[/b] – Discover fresh recipes to expand your culinary creations.
[*] [b]New Elite in Sunken Temple: Zyrath[/b] – Challenge the new elite enemy, Zyrath, in the Sunken Temple.
[list]
[*] Zyrath drops the [b]Token of Redemption[/b], required to reset veteran skills.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]UI Update[/b]: Adjusted the user interface for a darker, more immersive aesthetic.
[*] [b]Training Dummies Enhancements[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added resistances to dummies, enabling testing of skills like [i]Spell Rend[/i] and [i]Poison Rend[/i].
[*] Adjusted dummy levels, allowing players to select specific levels to test DPS.
[/list]
[*] [b]Minimap Update[/b]: Changed mineral colors on the minimap to grey for improved visibility.
[*] [b]DoTs and Debuffs[/b]: Some high-end Damage-over-Time effects and debuffs can no longer be cleansed or purified on the first attempt.
[*] [b]DEX Balance Change[/b]: Reduced critical chance bonus from Dexterity (from 0.5% to 0.4% per 10 DEX points).
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to obtain duplicate unique items from the chest house.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update! 

Let us know your feedback in the discussions, and happy adventuring!

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.4.0 - Stability
notes.content:
Greetings, brave adventurers! The [b]v0.8.4.0[/b] update for [b]Ancient Kingdoms[/b] has arrived, bringing a host of new features, balance tweaks, and bug fixes to enhance your journey through Eratiath! Dive into the details below and explore the enriched [i]pixel art RPG[/i] experience.

[h2]✨ New Features & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Upgraded to the [b]new Input System[/b] for smoother controls and improved responsiveness, enhancing your [i]action RPG[/i] gameplay.
[*]Updated [b]multiplayer library[/b] to the latest version for more stable [i]co-op[/i] and [i]online multiplayer[/i] sessions.
[*]Added [b]Vignette effect[/b] and [b]smoother camera movement[/b] for a more cinematic [i]fantasy[/i] adventure.
[*]Introduced [b]smart autoscroll[/b] in chat for seamless communication in [i]MMORPG[/i]-style interactions.
[*]Clarified that [b]Elixir of the Wildstride[/b] cannot be used in [i]dungeons[/i].
[*][b]Professions[/b] (Alchemy, Mining, Cooking, Herbalism, Radiant Seeker) now progress incrementally, mirroring the [i]Hunt[/i] profession for a deeper [i]crafting[/i] experience.
[*][b]Sleeping[/b] now removes all debuffs, refreshing your character for [i]exploration[/i].
[*]Opening the skills window with unspent [b]Veteran Skill Points[/b] now directs you to the [b]Veteran Window[/b] for quicker [i]character customization[/i].
[/list]

[h2]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced [b]mercenaries hiring price[/b] to make building your party more accessible in this [i]CRPG[/i].
[*][b]Veteran Skills[/b] "Leadership" and "Battlefield Restoration" moved to [b]Tier 1[/b] for earlier access in your [i]story-rich[/i] journey.
[*]Slightly reduced cast range for [b]Blightstorm (Scaleblight AoE)[/b] to balance [i]combat[/i].
[*][b]"Old Wyrm Scale"[/b] is now a [b]guaranteed drop[/b] from Scaleblight, rewarding your [i]dungeon crawler[/i] efforts.
[*]Increased cast time for [b]Leadership[/b] to refine [i]tactical[/i] gameplay.
[*][b]Mercenary cast animations[/b] are now faster, making [i]tap target combat[/i] feel snappier.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enhanced [b]stability and performance[/b] for database operations, ensuring a smoother [i]open world[/i] experience.
[*]Fixed [b]Elixir of the Wildstride[/b] incorrectly functioning in [i]dungeons[/i].
[*]Corrected [b]global map locations[/b] for new zones to improve [i]exploration[/i].
[*]Resolved issue with the [b]warrior mercenary skill "Steelrend"[/b].
[*]Fixed bugs in the [b]player animation manager[/b] for cleaner [i]pixel graphics[/i].
[*]Corrected [b]skill bonus issues[/b] from armor sets, enhancing [i]gear[/i] reliability.
[/list]

We’re committed to refining [b]Ancient Kingdoms[/b] during [i]Early Access[/i] with your feedback. Share your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.gg/8MkSWjXwab]Discord[/url] or in the [b]Steam Community Discussions[/b]! 

Thank you for crafting your legend in Eratiath. 🗡️

[i]~ The Ancient Kingdoms Team[/i]

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms v0.8.3.0 - QoL and Balance
notes.content:

[h2]⚔️ Gameplay Updates[/h2]

[*]You can now gather, mine, and open chests while in combat! [i]But beware[/i]: Enemies have a [b]higher critical chance[/b] when you do!

[*][b]Notes items[/b] now have gray titles instead of orange.
[*][b]Vaeltharos[/b] follow distance increased for smoother gameplay.
[*][b]Wild Growth[/b] icon updated for clarity.
[/list]

[h2]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Warrior[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Rupture[/b]: Increased AC reduction and now lasts [b]30s[/b].
[*][b]Rageblow[/b]: Now deals [b]full damage[/b], ignoring enemy AC.
[/list]
[*][b]Wizard[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Manaburn[/b]: Now deals [b]full damage[/b], bypassing enemy Magic Resist.
[/list]
[*][b]Druid[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Swiftness[/b]: Duration increased to [b]10 minutes[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Vaeltharos[/b]: Increased follow distance to prevent full HP during fear.

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed typo in [b]"Path of Warrior"[/b] quest.
[*]Fixed [b]Warrior[/b] bug with [b]Rupture[/b] when using a dagger.
[*]Fixed [b]Avatar of Water[/b] spawning with a higher level than intended.
[*]Fixed issues with retrieving [b]unique items[/b] from chest houses.
[*]Fixed bugs related to [b]backpacks[/b].
[*]Fixed bug affecting skill learning with [b]armor sets[/b].
[*]Disabled [b]Graphics Jobs[/b] in the Game Engine for better stability and to fix overlay issues.
[/list]

Embark on your adventure in the [b]Northern Wastes[/b] and test out these exciting changes! Share your feedback in the Steam Discussions or report any issues you encounter. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms - Big Update 0.6.17.0
notes.content:
Greetings, brave adventurers of Eratiath! A colossal update has arrived, packed with new features, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s everything you need to know about this epic patch:

[h2]Key Features & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Revamped Skills & Professions:[/b] Enjoy a sleek new Skills UI, an enhanced Veteran Skills Window, and a shiny Professions UI.
[*][b]New Professions:[/b] Master [i]Mining[/i], [i]Adventuring[/i], [i]Lorekeeping[/i], [i]Slayer[/i], [i]Exploring[/i], [i]Treasure Hunter[/i], and [i]Radiant Seeker[/i]—forge your own path!
[*][b]Temple of Valaark Overhaul:[/b] The entrance has been completely redesigned for a grander experience.
[*][b]New Spells - Wards:[/b] Protect yourself with shields that absorb damage up to their limit.
[*][b]Veteran Skills:[/b] Unlock [i]Leadership[/i], [i]Runeshield[/i], [i]Rageblow[/i], and [i]Ghoststab[/i]. Plus, base Veteran Skills now grant 2 attribute points per level!
[*][b]Adventurer’s Guild Upgrades:[/b] Merchants can now repair gear, and powerful new [i]Emblems[/i] are up for grabs.
[*][b]New Content:[/b] Explore a new Camp at Molten Summit and hunt for the rare [i]Cave Bag[/i] drop from Despair Worms.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added stunning FX effects to all traps.
[*]Mercenaries now buff and heal other players and mercs—stronger teamwork!
[*]Aggro outlines now visible when selecting players or mercs attacking monsters (a healer’s dream!).
[*]Treasure locations no longer block paths, and movement feels smoother when interacting with plants, minerals, or chests.
[*]Crafting superior-quality items now grants 3,000 EXP.
[*]Reduced out-of-combat delay from 6s to 5s.
[*]DoTs no longer trigger the Rest buff, but you can still exit combat.
[/list]

[h2]Warrior Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][i]Devastating Blow:[/i] Now usable with daggers and spears; rage cost increased.
[*][i]Threat[/i] and [i]Mighty Sweep:[/i] Rage costs increased.
[*][i]Battlefield Restoration:[/i] Now restores health AND mana/resources to mercenaries.
[*][i]Assassination:[/i] New visual effect added; targeting bug fixed.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a layering issue with a table in Bonebreach.
[*]Resolved potion crafting bugs at level 4.
[*]Mouse no longer passes through UI panels.
[*]Squashed minor typos and optimized the intro for high-res monitors.
[*]Adjusted Black Ice Deep armor molds: Higher drop rate, lower quality and sell price.
[*]Default Bloom intensity reduced from 1.5 to 1.25.
[*]Hopefully fixed elite/boss respawn issues—let us know!
[/list]

[h2]Quality-of-Life Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]All bows upgraded to a higher resolution.
[*]NPC chests can now be opened—at the cost of faction reputation.
[*]Cleric mercenaries now heal/buff smarter with slight randomness when paired.
[*]Added mercenary messages in the Vault of the Vanished (VoV).
[/list]

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]
This update is all about enhancing your journey through Eratiath—whether you’re slaying beasts, crafting masterpieces, or uncovering ancient treasures. Equip your gear, rally your mercenaries, and dive into the adventure!

Have feedback? Found a bug? Let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2241380/discussions/]Discussions[/url] or join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F8MkSWjXwab]Discord[/url] to chat with the community and dev team!

[i]May your blades stay sharp and your legends grow eternal![/i]

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms - Update v0.6.16.0
notes.content:
Greetings, brave adventurers!

We’ve been hard at work in the realm of [i]Ancient Kingdoms[/i], and today we’re thrilled to roll out a fresh update packed with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and fixes. Here’s what’s new in the world of Twilight Forest and beyond:

[h2]New Feature: Camps[/h2]
[list]
[*]Introducing [b]Camps[/b] in the Open World! These are clusters of 10-20 mobs with short respawn times, offering a [b]20% bonus EXP[/b] boost.

[*]The first camps, along with new elites, have been added around [b]Twilight Forest[/b]. Time to gather your party and dive in!

[list]
[*][b]Daily quests[/b] now grant more EXP to help you progress faster.
[*][b]Elites and bosses[/b] drop even more bonus EXP—hunt them down for maximum gains!
[*]Party players rejoice: the [b]bonus EXP per party member[/b] has jumped from [b]10% to 25%[/b]. Teamwork makes the dream work!
[/list]
[h2]UI & Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Revamped [b]Character Sheet UI[/b] for a cleaner experience.
[*]Adjusted [b]Orthographic size[/b] in Character Selection for better visibility.
[*]Shrunk the [b]chat font size[/b] to keep your screen tidier.
[*]Added sleek [b]new icons[/b] across the UI.
[*]All [b]weapon pixel art[/b] has been fully migrated to the new resolution.
[*]Fixed [b]Dryads idle animation[/b] and polished the [b]elf hairstyle side view[/b] for that extra flair.
[/list]
[h2]New Content & Items[/h2]
[list]
[*]More [b]new equipment[/b] added to expand your gear.
[*]Completing the initial [b]Despair main questline[/b] now rewards the shiny new [b]"Cave Bag"[/b] item!
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Traps[/b] can now be resisted based on your [b]magic or poison resistance[/b]—choose your stats wisely!
[*]Added [b]hit effect blending[/b] to players and pets for more satisfying combat feedback.
[*][b]Hardcore mode[/b] players can no longer claim non-tradable items from the house chest - survival just got tougher!
[*]Smoothed out [b]open door movement[/b] in the elven village.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes & Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various under-the-hood improvements to keep your journey through [i]Eratiath[/i] smooth and epic.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed crafting them! Let us know your thoughts in the Steam Discussions or on our socials—we’re always listening. Now, grab your gear, rally your allies, and conquer those camps!

Until next time,  
The [i]Ancient Pixels[/i] Team

notes.title: Ancient Kingdoms - Major Update!

Adventurers, prepare yourselves! A major update has arrived, bringing new content, balance changes, and crucial fixes to enhance your journey through Eratiath. Read on for all the details!

[h2]New Content & Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Epic Cleric Quest Begins![/b] The journey to prove your faith and power has started. Will you rise to the challenge?

[list]

[list]

[/list]

[b]Ranger Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Battle Preparations[/i] now increases attack power by [b]1-5%[/b].
[/list]

[b]Healing System Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Healers can now perform [b]Exceptional Heals[/b], based on their critical chance and Dexterity (DEX).
[/list]

[h2]General Changes & Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bosses are now immune to speed-changing effects[/b] but will still be affected by damage-over-time (DoT) effects that alter speed.
[*] Reduced respawn timer for [b]Captain Aerendyl[/b].
[*] Fixed Sylvaron respawning in a dead state after revival.

[/list]

That’s all for this update, adventurers! As always, thank you for your support, feedback, and passion for Ancient Kingdoms. Stay tuned for more updates, and may your journeys be legendary! ⚔️🔥

notes.title: Welcome to Ancient Kingdoms Early Access!
notes.content:
The wait is over. After five years of hard work, we are excited to release Ancient Kingdoms into Steam Early Access today!

The community’s response to our Steam Next Fest demo was absolutely amazing, and we’re beyond excited to begin this major next chapter of Ancient Kingdoms together. We want to extend a warm welcome to both new and returning players, and we’ll be listening closely to your feedback throughout Early Access as we continue adding fresh content and features. Ready to start—or pick up where you left off—on your epic quest? Head over to our Steam store page and dive right in!

[previewyoutube=pSH3PGs8TQI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Your Feedback Matters![/h1]

From our very first Alpha all the way to the Demo, your feedback has played a crucial role in shaping Ancient Kingdoms into what it is today. We’ve had an incredible time developing the game and getting to know our community, and we cannot thank you enough for all your support. There are plenty of exciting new features waiting for you in Early Access, and we’d love to hear your thoughts!

Bringing Ancient Kingdoms into Early Access is the perfect opportunity to welcome you into this world while we continue adding features and refining them based on your feedback. You’ve been part of the journey from the start, but now, you’ll get to experience bug fixes and regular updates in real time—and we find that pretty exciting!

You can share any feedback, suggestions, and bug reports in the dedicated channels of our Ancient Kingdoms [url=https://discord.gg/hPeup2Rp]Discord[/url]. We appreciate every comment and look forward to hearing what you think!


[h1]What’s Next for Ancient Kingdoms?[/h1]

Hearing your thoughts and feedback on the Early Access version of Ancient Kingdoms is our very first step on the road to full launch, and we’ll be sharing plenty of news and updates about this journey as we move forward.

We have a host of updates planned to continuously expand the world of Ancient Kingdoms as you explore its mystical realms. In the meantime, check out this exciting new roadmap for a glimpse of what’s in store for the future of Ancient Kingdoms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43844821/7737b9d90267368424c44aeede560ad7438ee16a.png[/img]

We’ll also be on the lookout for your bug reports, Tweets, Discord messages, livestreams, YouTube videos, TikToks, and more to see how you’re enjoying Ancient Kingdoms. From all of us on the development team, we hope you have a great time exploring, and you’ll be hearing much more from us about Ancient Kingdoms soon!
